invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.vendorDescription: Invoices you have created for your assigned branches.
invoices.adminDescription: Vendor invoices across all branches. Approval and payment are separate steps.
invoices.builderDescription: Totals are calculated with exact decimals and re-verified on the server.
invoices.paymentDetailsHint: Shown on the invoice. Never include card numbers or passwords.
invoices.submitConfirmBody: A permanent invoice number is assigned and the line items are locked. An administrator will review it.
invoices.noBranches: You don't have any active branch assignments, so you can't create invoices yet. An administrator must assign you to a branch.
invoices.locked: This invoice has been submitted and is locked.
invoices.revisionBanner: The administrator requested a revision. Update the invoice and submit the revision.
invoices.emptyBody: Create your first invoice for one of your assigned branches.
invoices.approveBody: Approval confirms the liability of {amount}. It does not mark the invoice as paid — record payments separately.
invoices.paymentNotYet: Payments can be recorded once the invoice is approved.
invoices.correctBody: Payments are never edited or deleted. A compensating entry of {amount} will be added and the balance restored.
invoices.snapshotVersions: {count, plural, one {# submitted version} other {# submitted versions}}
invoices.reconcileHint: If an employee also recorded this purchase, link it so it isn't counted twice.
invoices.DUPLICATE_OF: Duplicate of this invoice (excluded from totals)

supplies.title: Supply records
supplies.description: Log goods and services delivered to your assigned branches, then bill them on an invoice.
supplies.billSelected: Create invoice from {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}
supplies.sameBranch: Select records from a single branch to bill them together.
supplies.emptyBody: Record what you delivered; you can turn records into an invoice later.

vendorDash.subtitle: Your invoices and payments at a glance
vendorDash.invoiceCount: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
vendorDash.onlyYours: Only your own invoices are shown.

vendorBranches.title: My branches
vendorBranches.description: Branches you are currently authorized to supply and invoice.
vendorBranches.emptyBody: An administrator assigns branches to vendors. You'll be notified when that happens.

payments.title: Vendor payments
payments.description: Every payment and correction recorded against approved invoices. Entries are never edited — corrections are separate entries.
payments.outstandingDescription: Approved invoices with a remaining balance.
